stories.topic: Zaporizhzhia strikes, Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war
stories.text: A Russian airstrike hits a five-story apartment building in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine, killing two people and wounding 44 others.
Israel claims to have killed Hamas security official Naeem Abu Nahel in a airstrike in the Gaza Strip.
Police fire tear gas and stun grenades to disperse protesting garment workers across Gazipur, Savar, and Ashulia, Bangladesh, as production halts at 481 factories amid minimum wage disputes.
Thirteen people are killed and fourteen others are injured when a bus collides with a stationary truck in Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates.
Seven people are killed and nine others are injured in a cooking gas explosion at a hot pot restaurant in Hanoi, Vietnam.
A Turkish Air Force helicopter crashes during a training flight in Eskişehir, Turkey, killing five crew members.
The UK Health Security Agency says it recorded the highest number of heat-related deaths in the United Kingdom on record in 2026 at 5,258, surpassing the previous record in 2022.

stories.topic: Aftermath of the July Uprising, 2026 Bangladesh garment workers protests
stories.text: Border Guard Bangladesh deploys 101 platoons across Dhaka and seven other districts, including two battalions in Gopalganj, following instructions from the home ministry to increase surveillance at key installations and industrial areas.
Armed men in Cartagena, Colombia took 25 people hostage in a supermarket after a failed armored-car robbery.
Former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina announces she plans to return to the country on December 16, coinciding with Victory Day.

In association football, the Court of Arbitration for Sport rules in favor of Senegal against Morocco and reverses the Confederation of African Football's controversial decision to overturn Senegal's 1–0 victory in the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final.
